prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exceptionally polished native iPhone screen for MagicCuts Pro, a fully paid local sensor and connectivity instrument app. This is a production-quality interface composition, not a marketing poster or website. Flat screen pixels only, portrait aspect matching an iPhone 393 by 852 point viewport, no surrounding device or scene. Respect top status-bar and bottom home-indicator safe areas. Apple Watch face / Apple Compass / Oceanic dive computer standard of disciplined typography, purposeful data geometry, exact alignment, useful information hierarchy. Native SF Pro labels and SF rounded large measurement numerals, never tiny unreadable text. Color world: matte near-black #101315 ground, graphite #22272A wells only when useful, warm white #F4F6F5 text, cool secondary #A5B2B6, measured orange #FF8B52 for the selected reading/control, mint #94D8BE for a labeled passed condition. No gradients, glows, decoration, stock cards, faux metal, 3D hardware, hover affordances, or random circular progress rings. One beautiful dominant measurement geometry; quiet secondary content. Native iOS navigation and tab bar, tab labels Instruments, Sessions, Workflows; Instruments selected. A small legible 'Sample session' label makes all shown data explicitly illustrative. Do not invent unsupported measurements: no Wi-Fi RSSI, distance from Bluetooth signal, temperature sensor, background guarantee or cloud services. Top navigation has title Instruments and a small native settings icon. All actions should look tappable and remain at least 44 points. This is the main unlocked Pro experience. Composition A, 'Field Dial': a compact native instrument selector 'Bluetooth' / 'Motion' / 'Sound' below the title, Bluetooth selected. The center is an extraordinarily precise large open 250-degree RSSI instrument arc, like a calibrated watch complication, ticks and numeric scale -100 -80 -60 -40 dBm, one fine orange pointer at -62, a clearly labeled threshold tick at -70, and a small mint band spanning -66 to -60 labeled 'Middle 50%'. Arc only represents this defined signal range, not distance. Center white rounded numeral '-62' with 'dBm' below and source 'Desk sensor'. Under the instrument, restrained sentence '8 dB above your threshold'. Below that, an actual narrow time chart of signal over the last 20 seconds with an axis, orange line fluctuating between -66 and -60, visible gaps rather than invented continuity; threshold -70 dashed and labeled. Bottom action strip native capsule 'Record session' with round recording symbol, secondary 'Set baseline'. End just above native tab bar. Balanced negative space around the arc, strong dominant face. Primary geometry takes roughly 38 percent of the screen height. Do not duplicate source headings or put a boxed card around every element.
source: Built-in image generation; illustrative interface concept
